name: Bell County East to Big Hill
status: Route case filed March 26, 2026 with 122 route options. In August the state judges (SOAH) recommended denying it: need not shown, and about 1,400 landowners may not have been properly notified. On Sept. 11 the PUC sent it back to the judges for a supplemental recommendation on two points, so the decision is delayed and no route is chosen yet.
next_step: Waiting on the judges' supplemental recommendation, then a PUC vote. The PUC can still approve it. Energize target was end of 2030.
why_k2: Route options and the landowner list are public. The end substations (Big Hill, Schleicher County; Bell County East, Bell County) are fixed.
k2_action: Pull the landowner list and route map from Docket 59475; focus on parcels near both end substations. With the case delayed and possibly denied, weigh land near Big Hill (which other 765 kV lines also use) over land along the middle of the route.
endpoints: Big Hill (Schleicher County) to Bell County East (Bell County)
counties: Study area: Bell, Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Milam, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, Williamson
